title: Six Paths Vital Surge
body:
Syntax: perform six paths vital surge

Description: Channel Ashura's life force to restore 25% of your maximum Health and Stamina, capped at your current maximums, and clear poisoned and weakened effects. Self only; usable during combat. Costs 120 base Chakra with the normal Chakra Control discount; two-minute cooldown. Does not restore Chakra. At full resources with no relevant ailment, it consumes nothing. Unlocks at level 75 only for Ashura reincarnations of any combat class. Requires your Six Paths mode active. Train and use the technique to increase its mastery. Costs 120 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 120 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
